name: FastQC quality overview
description: Turn a saved FastQC quality summary into read-count, mean-quality and check-status figures plus a downloadable per-mate QC table. Uses the small summary table only: no FASTQ processing or database downloads.

inputs.label: FastQC quality summary
inputs.description: Add FastQC quality summary from Pipeline outputs. Needs r1_read_count, r1_avg_quality and r1_pass/warn/fail; the equivalent R2 columns are optional.

outputs.name: read_counts
outputs.label: Read counts by sample and mate
outputs.description: Reads per sample and mate; reads are not counted as read pairs.

outputs.name: mean_quality
outputs.label: Mean read quality
outputs.description: Mean per-sequence Phred quality for R1 and R2, not Q30.

outputs.name: check_status
outputs.label: Quality checks
outputs.description: FastQC PASS, WARN and FAIL check counts per mate.

outputs.name: qc_by_mate
outputs.label: Quality measurements by mate
outputs.description: One row per sample and available mate, with saved run provenance and missing values preserved.

report.introduction: Quality overview based on saved FastQC measurements. PASS, WARN and FAIL refer to individual quality checks, not to pipeline execution. Interpret these checks in the context of the samples and consult the original FastQC reports for details.

citation: Measurements: FastQC (retain the source pipeline's version and citation). Tabular processing: pandas. Figures: Plotly. Analysis code and environment: SeqDesk run provenance.
